text.p: dELiA*s Inc, a direct marketer of casual apparel, said on Monday that it expects a record year in 1997 after completing an initial public offering in October 1996.
"We expect to see yet another record year in 1997," chairman, president and chief executive Stephen Kahn said in a statement. "Sales and catalog requests are well above the same period last year."
A recent secondary offering raised $19 million and the company's balance sheet is "virtually debt-free," positioning the company for future growth.
In the year ended January 1997, the company reported sales of $30.2 million and proforma net income of $2.3 million, or $0.23 a share.
